notes.title: COMING THIS SEPTEMBER : ALTARAYS PODCAST
notes.notes:
ALTARAYS  is a real woman who has a special gift: she can connect with herself from parallel dimensions. She needs someone to act as a catalyst and she found someone in her childhood friend of hers who will be her guide on this experience through mystical Egypt.
In the paranormal world of Altarays, you will discover a more mystical and spiritual Egypt where the gods have something to tell you. Discover what he felt in astral travel and listen to the mission that the gods entrusted to him. The Altarays podcast will be published along with the title. It will have 5 chapters in Spanish, however, plans to make the English version will arrive soon.

The podcast will involve series of discussions and narrations about the VR out-of-body experience which is set to be released in September. This forms an important part of the overall experience. 

The Spotify link is available [url=https://open.spotify.com/show/3zHxiPS93CVxHpgGmjzksN?si=aeiJ5klbQVSf-eTPvNk3Pg&dl_branch=1&nd=1]here[/url]
